items.title: Writing an embedded OS in Rust on the Raspberry Pi
items.description: A set of tutorials that give a guided, step-by-step tour of how to write a monolithic Operating System kernel for an embedded system from scratch. Runs on the Raspberry Pi 3 and the Raspberry Pi 4.

items.title: Ferrous Systems' Embedded Training Courses: 2020-current edition
items.description: A hands-on training course for beginner and advanced learners of Embedded Rust, based on Nordic Semiconductor's nRF52840 hardware. This training was given at Oxidize Conferences and by Ferrous Systems to corporate customers.

items.title: impl Rust on ESP32 Book

items.title: Pico Pico Book

Platform agnostic crates to interface external components. These crates use the interface to support all the devices and systems that implement the traits.
The list below contains drivers that have achieved the "released" status. To add a driver to this list, please ensure that your driver has a short blog post, article, or sufficiently explanatory README showing an example of its use. Ideally, this post would demonstrate using the device in a small project so that a Rust and/or embedded newcomer can also understand it. Otherwise, please add it to the WIP section below.
